Let’s Make Taking Care of Your Eyes Easy

Family-Friendly Eye Care in Pine Beach

Book Appointment

For over 40 years, families in and around Pine Beach have trusted us with their vision. Today, that same commitment continues with care that’s built around you. From comprehensive eye exams to eye condition treatment, we make sure you and your family always feel looked after—because that’s how it should be.

We Do Things a Little Differently Here

Modern Vision Care with a Personal Touch

When you visit our Pine Beach eye clinic, we don’t rush you through your appointment or treat you like a number on a schedule. We take the time to understand what’s going on with your eyes, answer your questions, and make sure you feel comfortable every step of the way.

With a mix of experience, modern technology, and a team that truly cares, you’ll get the kind of attention that’s hard to find just anywhere.

(732) 978-9306

We See Kids, Parents, and Grandparents

Supporting Your Family’s Vision at Every Age

From a child’s first eye exam to helping adults stay ahead of changes in their vision, we’re here for every stage of life. Many of our patients come from Pine Beach, Beachwood, Toms River, and nearby communities, and a lot of them have been coming here for years.

It’s not unusual for us to see multiple generations of the same family, all in the same week. That’s the kind of place we’ve always been, and it’s something we’re proud to continue.

We’re Right Here When You Need Us

Our Services at Academy Vision

  • Comprehensive Eye Exams »

    A thorough look at your vision and eye health, so nothing gets missed and everything stays on track.

  • Dry Eye Treatment »

    If your eyes feel irritated, tired, or constantly dry, we’ll find the cause and help you get real relief.

  • Eye Disease Management »

    We keep a close eye on conditions such as glaucoma and macular degeneration to protect your vision long-term.

  • Myopia Management »

    If your child’s prescription keeps changing, we can help slow that progression and protect their future vision.

  • Pediatric Eye care »

    From first exams to school-age checkups, we make eye care easy and comfortable for kids.

  • LASIK Co-Management »

    Thinking about LASIK? We’ll guide you through the process and handle your care before and after.

Whatever Your Eyes Need, We’ve Got You

Whether you’re scheduling for your whole family or just taking a little time to focus on your own vision, our Pine Beach eye doctors are ready for you.

We’ll make the process comfortable and easy to fit into your day, so you can walk in feeling taken care of and leave seeing clearly.

(732) 978-9306

Services

  • Children's Eye Care »

    A first eye exam, glasses for the school year, a prescription that keeps changing—your child’s vision needs can shift a lot as they grow.

  • Emergency Eye Care »

    Eyes don’t pick convenient moments to act up. A branch catches you while you’re trimming the hedges, one eye turns red and sore overnight, or a blur shows up that wasn’t there yesterday.

  • Contact Lens Exams »

    A contact lens exam is a little different from a standard eye exam. We take extra measurements to make sure your lenses sit properly on your eyes and stay comfortable throughout the day.
